Tiffany & Co. (known colloquially as Tiffany or Tiffany's) is an American luxury jewelry and specialty retailer, headquartered in New York City . It sells jewelry, sterling silver, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, water bottles, watches and personal accessories, as well as some leather goods.
Tiffany is renowned for its luxury goods and is particularly known for its diamond and sterling silver jewelry. It markets itself as an arbiter of taste and style. Many of these goods are sold at Tiffany stores, as well as through direct-mail and corporate merchandising.
In 1919, the company made a revision to the Medal of Honor on behalf of the United States Department of the Navy. This Tiffany Cross version was rare because it was awarded only for combat, using the previous design for non-combat awards. In 1942, the Navy established the Tiffany version for non-combat heroism as well but, in August 1942, the Navy subsequently eliminated the Tiffany Cross and the two-medal system.
In 1956, legendary designer Jean Schlumberger joined Tiffany, and Andy Warhol collaborated with the company to create Tiffany holiday cards (circa 1956–1962).[14][21] In 1968, Lady Bird Johnson, First Lady of the U.S. at the time, commissioned Tiffany to design a White House china-service that featured 90 flowers.[22][23]
In November 1978, Tiffany & Co. was sold to Avon Products Inc. for about US$104 million in stock. However, in a 1984 Newsweek article, the Fifth Avenue Tiffany store was likened to the Macy's department store during a white sale, due to the high number of inexpensive items on sale; furthermore, customers complained about declining quality and service. In August 1984, Avon sold Tiffany to an investor group led by William R. Chaney for US$135.5 million in cash. Tiffany went public again in 1987 and raised about US$103.5 million from the sale of 4.5 million shares of common stock.
Due to the 1990–1991 recession in the United States, Tiffany commenced an emphasis upon mass merchandising. A new campaign was launched that stressed how Tiffany could be affordable for all; for example, the company advertised that the price of diamond engagement rings started at US$850. “How to Buy a Diamond” brochures were sent to 40,000 people, who called a toll-free number specifically set up to target the broader population. However, to maintain its image as a luxury goods company, high-style images remained on display in Tiffany stores.

High-poly seesaw for small children from about 3 - 6 years of age, made from Robinia wood. Modelled according to the European standard for (public) playground equipment EN 1176. A swimming pool, swimming bath, wading pool, paddling pool, or simply pool is a structure designed to hold water to enable swimming or other leisure activities. In-ground pools are most commonly constructed from materials such as concrete, natural stone, metal, plastic, or fiberglass, and can be of a custom size and shape or built to a standardized size, the largest of which is the Olympic-size swimming pool.
Many health clubs, fitness centers, and private clubs have pools used mostly for exercise or recreation. Many towns and cities provide public pools. Many hotels have pools available for their guests to use at their own leisure. Educational facilities such as high schools and universities sometimes have pools for physical education classes, recreational activities, leisure, and competitive athletics such as swimming teams. Hot tubs and spas are pools filled with hot water, used for relaxation or hydrotherapy. They are common in hotels and health clubs, and can also be found in many private homes. Special swimming pools are also used for diving, specialized water sports, and physical therapy, as well as for the training of lifeguards and astronauts. Swimming pools may be heated or unheated.

description_text:
Modern turnstile conceptualised to match modern day pandemic scenario. Designed keeping in mind that turnstile and token trasaction kiosks are a point of convergence for a crowd and close proximity should be avoided. Also the idea that a user must not feel clustered or isolated thus avoiding the use of opaque walls and glasses. Thus a turnstile with glass barriers was thought. The scanners can be placed on either sides of entry keeping both left handed and right handed users in mind such that minimum time is spent at such a place where crowd converges. Best suited for place of public gathering like metro stations, bus stations, airports, offices,etc
Glass barriers are keyed with a driver and driven set key constraints. UVs are mapped and equal texel density is maintained.
Do provide with feedback and ideas if you feel there is a problem worth ideating for modern day solutions

This model is a high-end, photorealistic 3D model, that will help you to add realism to your project. The model is highly accurate and based on the manufacturer's original dimensions and technical data.
The model was initially created and fully textured in Blender 2.91, then rendered using Cycles.

All textures and materials are tailored and applied for high-quality render results. Some or all of the materials and textures may be made with Blender's shader nodes. You will get the best results in Blender.
No extra plugins are required for this model. Lights and cameras are not included in the scene.
If this model has stl extension in the file list, stl files have not been tested by printing. If you have any questions while printing, feel free to contact me.

description_text:
A LED display is a flat panel display that uses an array of light-emitting diodes as pixels for a video display. Their brightness allows them to be used outdoors where they are visible in the sun for store signs and billboards. In recent years, they have also become commonly used in destination signs on public transport vehicles, as well as variable-message signs on highways. LED displays are capable of providing general illumination in addition to visual display, as when used for stage lighting or other decorative (as opposed to informational) purposes.
BioTech Industries is a fictional brand name that I use on all sci-fi models**
Hand-painted using Substance Painter. PBR - AR/ VR - Low-Poly
Google, YouTube, Unity and Unreal Engine Friendly
Game-ready
Textures; 2048 x 2048, OpenGL, Dilation + Single Background Colour, 16 Pixel Padding
Maps Include; Base, Normal, Height, Rough, and Metal.
Screen is a separate object part and texture to enable easy exchange/ animation
Please note; This may, or may not 3D Print. Not tested.

description_text:
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.
